descriptionChirho: Adjective describing moral crookedness, perversity, or distortion of character, used of persons, speech, or ways. All seven sense clusters represent the same adjectival meaning with purely morphological variation (singular/plural, construct/absolute, with prepositions or conjunctions). Spanish consistently 'perverso/torcidos/torcido,' Hindi 'tedhe/tedhi/tedha/aur kutil,' Arabic 'al-multawi/mu'wajj/a'waj,' Korean 'bittungeo-jin/gupeun/bittuleojin,' Swahili 'mpotovu/zimepotoka/kilichopotoka.' No semantic differentiation exists across these forms; the variation is entirely grammatical.
